cohort: Pregnant rats administered vitamin A or corn oil on days 10-12 of pregnancy, and their fetuses delivered via cesarean section at P19.
finding: Subteratogenic doses of vitamin A, particularly 20000 IU/kg, significantly affected fetal rat kidney morphology by increasing renal volume (V), glomeruli per unit area (N<sub>A</sub>g), and glomeruli diameter (D).
